rounding: none (seconds kept; per-column rounding graded after the fact)
high_latitude_rule: MiddleOfTheNight (widens the substitution guard so the pure 15 deg angle stands; at China latitudes no guard binds)
margin_note: the printed columns carry no margins: 日中 is local apparent noon and 日没 is geometric sunset, so dhuhr +5 and maghrib +5 live in the prose only
